title: Does the 600 kg load rating of a bogie-hearth furnace include the rack for shaft parts?
summary: For a bogie-hearth furnace heating shafts and small parts, first compare the space, supports and temperature conditions using a loading layout that includes the fixtures. Then compare instruments, testing and supply scope against the actual measurement requirements. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s RT4-75-6 proposal dated 2 November 2021 specified a 900×600×600 mm effective heating zone, a 500–650℃ operating range and 75 kW heating power. Whether its proposed 600 kg rated load included fixtures was not defined. The quotation covered equipment design, manufacture, transport, installation and commissioning, providing a starting point for similar enquiries.
